lines.text: Here's how to set up SEO in Ryze — from an empty workspace to articles publishing themselves.

Start with your data. On the Integrations page, connect Google Search Console — that's where your keywords and rankings come from. Then connect Google Analytics, so we see traffic and conversions. And one more thing — your publishing platform. Open Commerce: Shopify, WordPress, Wix, Webflow, Framer — any platform works. Here it's Shopify, so we connect that. That's where your articles will be published.
Now head to Queries. It's empty — everything in Ryze builds on setup. So hit Run setup.

The agent pulls your Search Console data and researches what your customers actually type. Give it a minute. And here they are. Notice there are just five — that's on purpose. We don't chase hundreds of keywords: each month we focus on five active ones, the five we know we can actually move you up on.
Prompts start too. These are the questions your buyers ask AI assistants — and we track how often the answers mention you.

Next, articles. Open the Content Plan — it's already full. Every article is written around those keywords, and they publish five a day: fast enough to grow, and a pace Google is completely comfortable with.
Check Mentions too. Press releases and guest posts are already being prepared and placed for you — and backlinks land here through the month as the network does its work.
Setup runs a site scan as well. Open Technical Audit — every issue on your site is already found and listed, ready to fix.
And the Dashboard is live — search performance, positions and backlinks. There's a GEO tab too — that's your visibility inside AI answers.
Now give it a day and come back to the plan. Refresh — and look at that: five articles are already published, live on your site.
That's the whole setup. Connect your data, pick your platform — Shopify, WordPress, or anything else — hit Run setup once, and from here everything ships itself.
